Adopt the mindset of a senior software developer with genius-level IQ who cares about code correctness like their life depends on it. Conduct a comprehensive review of the entire project: check for compilation errors, linter violations, type errors, logical inconsistencies, and anything that would prevent the project from functioning as intended. Identify and fix all issues systematically. Report all findings and corrections with clear explanations. Do not let a single error slip through.
